## What and why

I describe the change and the reason for it.

## How I verified it

I record exact commands and observed results.

## Checklist

- [ ] One self-contained change.
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally and in CI.
- [ ] Tests cover new behaviour.
- [ ] Exported symbols are documented, with no unfinished markers, commented-out code or console output.
- [ ] New user-facing strings exist in Arabic and English.
- [ ] New entry points enforce server-side authorisation; code, logs and URLs contain no secret or personal data.
- [ ] API, schema and infrastructure follow-ups are complete.
- [ ] The changelog and relevant architecture decisions are updated.
- [ ] Every claim is backed by recorded output.

## Limitations

I state the remaining limitations and their implications.
